titleEn: Check Hat, Check Water, Off We Go!

pages.text: "I can pack by myself!" Mio, who wanted to do everything alone, put on a purple bag. A hat and water bottle stood side by side on the shoe rack. Mio rushed past them to the door.
"I will reach the river first and find flat pebbles!" Careless Duri waved a hat. "Mio, your hat!" Mio gripped both bag straps and crossed the threshold.
Teacher Bau led the group across the village road. At the river, the sun was bright. Pebbles gleamed white.
Dazzled, Mio could not see the pebbles well. Sweat rolled from their forehead. "Oh... my eyes sting, and I am thirsty."
Everyone took out water bottles and drank. Duri offered theirs. "Mio, have a sip." Mio shook their head and sat alone in the reed shade.
Duri sat beside Mio, tapping fingers to show each item. "We did this before leaving. Check hat, check water, off we go!" From the shade, Mio could only watch the pebble shore.
Friends chose flat pebbles and threw them into the river. Plop, plop! Mio held none. "I want to go there too..." Their eyes stung with tears.
Teacher Bau knelt beside Mio and put a straw hat on their head. "Mio, what was on the shoe rack this morning?" Mio said softly, "A hat and... water bottle."
On the next picnic morning, Mio stopped at the rack. "One, check hat! Two, check water! Three, shoes on and off we go!" The bag filled out. Check hat, check water, off we go!
At the river, Mio wore a hat and held an armful of pebbles. Teacher Bau gently stroked between Mio's ears. Packing first kept play fun to the end. "Teacher, look! Check hat, check water, off we go!"
